title: default_budget in balance.json is dead data — no Balance struct field, loader read, or consumer
evidence:
data/balance.json:26 →
  "default_budget": 5200,

core/catalog.odin Balance struct (lines 99-101) jumps from the weights straight to the inventory with no budget field:
	emphasis_preset:              [3]i32,
	starting_links:               [dynamic]i32, // per pipe-tier index
	starting_routers:             [dynamic]i32, // per node-type index (routers)

The balance loader (catalog.odin:346-467) reads logic_hz, snap_radius, ..., emphasis_preset, starting_inventory, grants, packet_pool_cap, rolling_window_ticks, growth_* — never default_budget. grep `default_budget` across all *.odin in core/ app/ harness/ = 0 hits. Edit_Error (types.odin:32) has Out_Of_Links/Out_Of_Routers, no Over_Budget.
detail: The budget→inventory ruling (0b92fa4) orphaned this field: no Balance struct field, no loader read, zero consumers. A no-op edit trips the catalog-hash drift CI gate — drift bait, same class as r1's rolling_window_ticks.
recommended_fix: Delete `default_budget` from data/balance.json (the inventory tray's starting_links/starting_routers + grants fully replace it).

The HUD draws the hardware tray (hud.odin:57 draw_tray; snap.inv_links/inv_routers), not a budget; demolish now refunds a link/router into the inventory tray (main.odin:374 "pipe demolished - refund banked"), not a budget.
